title: Keto Indulgent Portuguese Savoy Cabbage Pasta
description: A tangy and indulgent Portuguese dish featuring savoy cabbage and a keto-friendly pasta water emulsion, perfect for a special occasion.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and blanch the chopped savoy cabbage for 5 minutes.
Shock the blanched cabbage in an ice bath to stop the cooking process.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the minced garlic until fragrant.
Add the zucchini noodles to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until slightly tender.
In a small bowl, whisk together the lemon juice and melted butter to create a pasta water emulsion.
Add the emulsion to the skillet with the zucchini noodles and toss to combine.
Add the blanched savoy cabbage to the skillet and toss to combine with the noodles and emulsion.
Season the dish with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the dish to a serving platter and top with shaved Grana Padano cheese.
